import HartshorneLib.Chapter4UniformizerDifferential
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SimplePoleResidueAlgebra

/-!
# Residues of differentials with at most a simple pole

The inverse maximal-ideal lattice consists of rational differentials whose
product with every element of the maximal ideal is regular. Multiplication by
a uniformizer identifies it with the regular differential lattice. The residue
is the residue-field value of the coefficient of `dt` in `t * omega`.

This is the simple-pole part of the residue construction underlying curve
Serre duality (Hartshorne, III.7 and IV.1). It does not construct residues for
arbitrary poles or the global trace.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Rational differentials with at most a simple pole at a point. The domain
is defined by its maximal ideal and contains no choice of local parameter. -/
def curveSimplePoleDifferentials (x : X.left) :
    Submodule (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveRationalDifferentials X) where
  carrier := {ω | ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x),
    a • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro ω η hω hη a ha
    simpa only [smul_add] using (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).add_mem
      (hω a ha) (hη a ha)
  smul_mem' := by
    intro b ω hω a ha
    simpa only [smul_comm a b] using
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem b (hω a ha)

/-- Every regular differential has at most a simple pole. -/
theorem curveRegularDifferentialLattice_le_simplePole (x : X.left) :
    curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x ≤ curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x := by
  intro ω hω a _
  exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem a hω

/-- Multiplication by an element of the maximal ideal regularizes a
differential with at most a simple pole. -/
def curveSimplePoleRegularization (x : X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : t ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x where
  toFun ω := ⟨t • (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X), ω.property t ht⟩
  map_add' _ _ := Subtype.ext (smul_add _ _ _)
  map_smul' a ω := Subtype.ext (smul_comm t a (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X))

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleRegularization_coe (x : X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : t ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    (curveSimplePoleRegularization X x t ht ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      t • (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := rfl

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A local parameter belongs to the maximal ideal of the curve stalk. -/
theorem curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    t ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  rw [ht.maximalIdeal_eq]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton t)

/-- The local regular differential represented by the product with a specified
uniformizer. -/
def curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      CurveStalkDifferentials X x :=
  (curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (curveSimplePoleRegularization X x t (curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht))

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
      (curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ω) =
        t • (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x).apply_symm_apply
    (curveSimplePoleRegularization X x t (curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht) ω))

/-- Residue-field coefficient of a simple-pole differential, computed using a
specified local parameter. -/
def curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible [IsAlgClosed k] {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  (Algebra.linearMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))).comp
    ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      (curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht))

variable [IsAlgClosed k]

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω =
      residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
          (curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ω)) := rfl

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- The local regularization of a regular differential is just its local
representative multiplied by the parameter. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_of_regular {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (η : CurveStalkDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht
      ⟨KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField η,
        curveRegularDifferentialLattice_le_simplePole X x ⟨η, rfl⟩⟩ = t • η := by
  apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
  rw [curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map, map_smul]

/-- The simple-pole residue vanishes exactly on regular differentials. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω = 0 ↔
      (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let e := curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht
  let α := curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ω
  constructor
  · intro h
    change residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (e.symm α) = 0 at h
    rw [residue_eq_zero_iff, ht.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
    refine ⟨e a, ?_⟩
    have htK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ≠ 0 :=
      map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
    apply smul_right_injective (M := CurveRationalDifferentials X) htK
    simp only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
    rw [← map_smul, ← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm t a, ha, e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map X hx t ht ω
  · rintro ⟨η, hη⟩
    have hω : ω =
        ⟨KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField η,
          curveRegularDifferentialLattice_le_simplePole X x ⟨η, rfl⟩⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext hη.symm
    rw [hω, curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply,
      curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_of_regular, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
    have htres : residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t = 0 := by
      rw [residue_eq_zero_iff]
      exact curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht
    rw [htres, zero_mul]

/-- The simple-pole residue is independent of the local parameter. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_eq {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht =
      curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx s hs := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  ext ω
  apply residue_differentialCoordinate_eq_of_smul_eq t s ht hs
    (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht)
    (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs)
    (by simp) (by simp)
  apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
  simp only [map_smul, curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map]
  exact smul_comm s t (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X)

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- A uniformizer tests membership in the intrinsic simple-pole lattice. -/
theorem mem_curveSimplePoleDifferentials_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ω ∈ curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x ↔
      t • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h t (curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht)
  · intro h a ha
    rw [ht.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at ha
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ha
    simpa only [mul_smul] using (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem b h

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- Every regular differential is obtained by clearing a simple pole with a
specified uniformizer. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleRegularization_surjective {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    Function.Surjective
      (curveSimplePoleRegularization X x t (curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht)) := by
  intro η
  let tK := algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t
  have htK : tK ≠ 0 :=
    map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
  let ω := tK⁻¹ • (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X)
  have hmul : t • ω = (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField t]
    change tK • (tK⁻¹ • (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X)) = _
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ htK, one_smul]
  have hω : ω ∈ curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x :=
    (mem_curveSimplePoleDifferentials_iff X hx t ht ω).mpr (hmul.symm ▸ η.property)
  exact ⟨⟨ω, hω⟩, Subtype.ext hmul⟩

/-- The simple-pole residue map is onto the residue field. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_surjective {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    Function.Surjective (curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht) := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := residue_surjective (R := X.left.presheaf.stalk x) c
  let η := curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht a
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := curveSimplePoleRegularization_surjective X hx t ht
    (curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x η)
  refine ⟨ω, ?_⟩
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply]
  change residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
      ((curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x).symm
        (curveSimplePoleRegularization X x t
          (curveUniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal X hx t ht) ω))) = c
  rw [hω, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simpa only [η, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using ha

/-- The intrinsic simple-pole residue. A parameter is selected to define it;
`curveSimplePoleResidue_eq` proves independence of that selection. -/
def curveSimplePoleResidue {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let h := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  exact curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx h.choose h.choose_spec

/-- The intrinsic residue can be computed with any local parameter. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidue_eq {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleResidue X hx = curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht := by
  unfold curveSimplePoleResidue
  exact curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_eq X hx _ t _ ht

/-- The kernel of the intrinsic residue consists exactly of regular
differentials. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidue_eq_zero_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleResidue X hx ω = 0 ↔
      (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidue_eq X hx t ht]
  exact curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_iff X hx t ht ω

/-- Every residue-field value is attained by an intrinsic simple-pole
residue. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidue_surjective {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    Function.Surjective (curveSimplePoleResidue X hx) := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidue_eq X hx t ht]
  exact curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_surjective X hx t ht

/-- The logarithmic differential `dt / t`, viewed in the intrinsic
simple-pole lattice. -/
def curveUniformizerLogDifferential {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x := by
  let tK := algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t
  have htK : tK ≠ 0 :=
    map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
  refine ⟨tK⁻¹ • KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    X.left.functionField (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t), ?_⟩
  rw [mem_curveSimplePoleDifferentials_iff X hx t ht,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField t]
  change tK • (tK⁻¹ • _) ∈ _
  rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ htK, one_smul]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
@[simp]
theorem curveUniformizerLogDifferential_coe {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)⁻¹ •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t) := rfl

/-- The intrinsic residue has the normalization `res(dt / t) = 1` for every
local parameter, without dependence on a selected parameter. -/
@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleResidue_logDifferential {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleResidue X hx (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht) = 1 := by
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidue_eq X hx t ht, curveSimplePoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply]
  have hlocal : curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht
      (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht) =
        KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t := by
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    rw [curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map, curveUniformizerLogDifferential_coe,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField t, smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero),
      one_smul]
  rw [hlocal]
  have he : KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t =
      curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht 1 := by simp
  rw [he, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_one]

/-- The kernel of the residue is the regular differential submodule inside
the simple-pole lattice. -/
theorem ker_curveSimplePoleResidue {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    LinearMap.ker (curveSimplePoleResidue X hx) =
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).comap (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x).subtype := by
  ext ω
  exact curveSimplePoleResidue_eq_zero_iff X hx ω

/-- Residue identifies simple principal parts of differentials with the
residue field. The equivalence is independent of any local parameter. -/
def curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquiv {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x ⧸
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).comap (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x).subtype)
      ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x] ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ker_curveSimplePoleResidue X hx).symm).trans
    ((curveSimplePoleResidue X hx).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
      (curveSimplePoleResidue_surjective X hx))

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquiv_mk {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquiv X hx (Submodule.Quotient.mk ω) =
      curveSimplePoleResidue X hx ω := by
  simp [curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquiv]

end
end Hartshorne
